function RewindHit.Methods:_checkRewoundHit(from: Vector3, to: Vector3)
	local whitelist = {}
	for _, position in { from, to } do
		local chunk = ChunkManager.GetChunk(position)
		if chunk and ChunkManager.IsChunkActive(chunk) then
			for entity in chunk.Entities do
				whitelist[entity] = true
			end
		end
	end

	-- Collect in-range candidates (no raycasts yet) into the reusable buffer.
	-- Each entity is tested against BOTH its rewound Head and Body spheres
	-- (see the module doc comment's "Head + Body hurtboxes" section) --
	-- Head is checked first and wins outright if in range (the two spheres
	-- are independent, not required to nest -- see Entity.luau).
	local candidates = self._candidateBuf
	for entity in whitelist do
		if entity ~= self.Source and not self._ignore[entity] and (not self.Filter or self.Filter(entity)) then
			local cache = self._rewindCache[entity]
			if not cache then
				cache = {
					Body = entity:GetBodyPositionAt(self._rewindTime),
					Head = entity:GetHeadPositionAt(self._rewindTime),
				}
				self._rewindCache[entity] = cache
			end

			local matchedHead = false
			if cache.Head then
				local closest, distance = Math.closestPointOnSegment(cache.Head, from, to)
				if distance <= entity.HeadRadius + self.Radius then
					table.insert(candidates, {
						entity = entity,
						point = closest,
						distAlong = (closest - from).Magnitude,
						hurtbox = "Head",
					})
					matchedHead = true
				end
			end
			if not matchedHead then
				local closest, distance = Math.closestPointOnSegment(cache.Body, from, to)
				if distance <= entity.HitboxRadius + self.Radius then
					table.insert(candidates, {
						entity = entity,
						point = closest,
						distAlong = (closest - from).Magnitude,
						hurtbox = "Body",
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Nearest-first: sort ascending by distance along the segment, then
	-- LOS-check in order, returning the first unobstructed one. This matches
	-- the old "bestDistAlong, clear only" survivor exactly.
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		return a.distAlong < b.distAlong
	end)

	for _, c in candidates do
		-- line-of-sight: real geometry must not block the shot before it would
		-- reach this point, so stale rewound data can never be used to hit
		-- someone through a wall. The hit instance must not belong to the
		-- candidate itself, so a target's own body can't block hitting it.
		local los = workspace:Raycast(from, c.point - from, self._rayParams)
		local blocked = los ~= nil
			and (los.Position - from).Magnitude < c.distAlong - 0.5
			and Entity.Get(los.Instance) ~= c.entity
		if not blocked then
			-- drain the buffer for this frame so the next substep starts clean
			-- (Step already clears it, but this keeps the function honest if
			-- ever called from elsewhere).
			table.clear(candidates)
			return c.entity, c.point, Math.safeUnit(from - c.point, Vector3.yAxis), c.hurtbox
		end
	end

	table.clear(candidates)
	return nil
end

return RewindHit
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/Projectile/RewindHit.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/server/ProjectileParallel.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
--[[
	Parallel, read-only projectile math coordinator.

	Actors compute acceleration and curvature hints from immutable snapshots.
	This module alone consumes their SharedTable results and publishes hints to
	the authoritative projectile loop. Workers never mutate projectile objects,
	active arrays, entities, signals, Instances, or replication state.
]]

local SharedTableRegistry = game:GetService("SharedTableRegistry")

local ProjectileParallel = {}

local MIN_PARALLEL_PROJECTILES = 128
local HINT_MAX_AGE_FRAMES = 120

type Worker = {
	actor: Actor,
	input: SharedTable,
	output: SharedTable,
	generation: number,
	pending: any?,
}

local workers: { Worker } = {}
local knownActors: { [Actor]: boolean } = {}
local hints: { [number]: any } = {}
local frame = 0
local stats = {
	BatchesDispatched = 0,
	ItemsDispatched = 0,
	BatchesCompleted = 0,
	ItemsCompleted = 0,
	BusyWorkers = 0,
	HintHits = 0,
	HintMisses = 0,
}

local function refreshWorkers()
	local folder = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("ProjectileActors")
	if not folder then return end
	for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Actor") and not knownActors[child] then
			local id = tonumber(string.match(child.Name, "(%d+)$"))
			if id then
				knownActors[child] = true
				table.insert(workers, {
					actor = child,
					input = SharedTableRegistry:GetSharedTable(`RelativityProjectileInput{id}`),
					output = SharedTableRegistry:GetSharedTable(`RelativityProjectileOutput{id}`),
					generation = 0,
					pending = nil,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(workers, function(a, b) return a.actor.Name < b.actor.Name end)
end

function ProjectileParallel.Collect()
	refreshWorkers()
	for _, worker in workers do
		local pending = worker.pending
		if pending and worker.output.done == pending.generation then
			for index, snapshot in pending.snapshots do
				local base = (index - 1) * 4
				local id = worker.output[base + 1]
				if id == snapshot.Id then
					hints[id] = {
						Velocity = worker.output[base + 2],
						AccelerationVector = worker.output[base + 3],
						CurvatureDt = worker.output[base + 4],
						Acceleration = snapshot.Acceleration,
						AccelerationDirection = snapshot.AccelerationDirection,
						Gravity = snapshot.Gravity,
						Frame = pending.frame,
					}
				end
			end
			stats.BatchesCompleted += 1
			stats.ItemsCompleted += #pending.snapshots
			worker.pending = nil
		end
	end
end

function ProjectileParallel.GetHint(projectile: any)
	local hint = hints[projectile.Id]
	if hint
		and hint.Velocity == projectile.Velocity
		and hint.Acceleration == projectile.Acceleration
		and hint.AccelerationDirection == projectile.AccelerationDirection
		and hint.Gravity == projectile.Gravity
	then
		stats.HintHits += 1
		return hint
	end
	stats.HintMisses += 1
	return nil
end

function ProjectileParallel.Dispatch(projectiles: { any })
	frame += 1
	refreshWorkers()
	if #projectiles < MIN_PARALLEL_PROJECTILES or #workers == 0 then
		if #projectiles == 0 then table.clear(hints) end
		return
	end

	local available = {}
	for _, worker in workers do
		if not worker.pending then
			table.insert(available, worker)
		else
			stats.BusyWorkers += 1
		end
	end
	if #available == 0 then return end

	local partitions = table.create(#available)
	for index = 1, #available do partitions[index] = {} end
	for index, projectile in projectiles do
		table.insert(partitions[(index - 1) % #available + 1], projectile)
	end

	for index, worker in available do
		local list = partitions[index]
		if #list == 0 then continue end
		worker.generation += 1
		local snapshots = table.create(#list)
		for itemIndex, projectile in list do
			local base = (itemIndex - 1) * 5
			worker.input[base + 1] = projectile.Id
			worker.input[base + 2] = projectile.Velocity
			worker.input[base + 3] = projectile.Acceleration
			worker.input[base + 4] = projectile.AccelerationDirection or false
			worker.input[base + 5] = projectile.Gravity
			snapshots[itemIndex] = {
				Id = projectile.Id,
				Acceleration = projectile.Acceleration,
				AccelerationDirection = projectile.AccelerationDirection,
				Gravity = projectile.Gravity,
			}
		end
		worker.pending = { generation = worker.generation, snapshots = snapshots, frame = frame }
		worker.actor:SendMessage("ComputeProjectileHints", worker.generation, #list)
		stats.BatchesDispatched += 1
		stats.ItemsDispatched += #list
	end

	if frame % HINT_MAX_AGE_FRAMES == 0 then
		for id, hint in hints do
			if frame - hint.Frame > HINT_MAX_AGE_FRAMES then hints[id] = nil end
		end
	end
end

function ProjectileParallel.GetStats()
	return table.clone(stats)
end

return ProjectileParallel
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/ProjectileParallel.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/server/ProjectileWorkerBootstrap.server.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
-- Creates a small Actor pool, then each clone performs read-only math in a
-- parallel message callback. Results are written to per-worker SharedTables.

local SharedTableRegistry = game:GetService("SharedTableRegistry")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local actor = script:GetActor()
if not actor then
	local folder = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("ProjectileActors")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "ProjectileActors"
		folder.Parent = script.Parent
	end
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local inputKey = `RelativityProjectileInput{index}`
		local outputKey = `RelativityProjectileOutput{index}`
		if not SharedTableRegistry:GetSharedTable(inputKey) then
			SharedTableRegistry:SetSharedTable(inputKey, SharedTable.new())
		end
		if not SharedTableRegistry:GetSharedTable(outputKey) then
			SharedTableRegistry:SetSharedTable(outputKey, SharedTable.new())
		end
	end
	if #folder:GetChildren() == 0 then
		for index = 1, 4 do
			local workerActor = Instance.new("Actor")
			workerActor.Name = `ProjectileWorker{index}`
			local workerScript = script:Clone()
			workerScript.Name = "Worker"
			workerScript.Parent = workerActor
			workerActor.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	return
end

local workerId = assert(tonumber(string.match(actor.Name, "(%d+)$")), "Projectile worker requires a numeric suffix")
local ProjectileMotion = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("ProjectileMotion"))
local input = SharedTableRegistry:GetSharedTable(`RelativityProjectileInput{workerId}`)
local output = SharedTableRegistry:GetSharedTable(`RelativityProjectileOutput{workerId}`)

actor:BindToMessageParallel("ComputeProjectileHints", function(generation: number, count: number)
	for index = 1, count do
		local inputBase = (index - 1) * 5
		local outputBase = (index - 1) * 4
		local id = input[inputBase + 1]
		local velocity = input[inputBase + 2]
		local acceleration = input[inputBase + 3]
		local direction = input[inputBase + 4]
		local gravity = input[inputBase + 5]
		if direction == false then direction = nil end
		local accelerationVector = ProjectileMotion.GetAcceleration(velocity, acceleration, direction, gravity)
		output[outputBase + 1] = id
		output[outputBase + 2] = velocity
		output[outputBase + 3] = accelerationVector
		output[outputBase + 4] = ProjectileMotion.GetCurvatureStepDt(velocity, accelerationVector, 0.35)
	end
	output.done = generation
end)
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/ProjectileWorkerBootstrap.server.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/init.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient (client rendering, purely cosmetic)
	Receives the server-authoritative Projectile system's replication stream
	(ProjSpawn/ProjMove/ProjHit/ProjSync/ProjTimeScale/ProjRay, over
	VisualOffload -- see ServerScriptService.Server.Projectile/Replication.luau
	for the sending side and its module doc comment for the full sync
	protocol) and renders tracers/impacts. This module never makes a gameplay
	decision -- no hit detection, no damage, no entity access -- it only draws
	what the server tells it happened. All client-side simulation between
	updates is dead-reckoning for smoothness; the server's own independent Step
	is always authoritative, and any visual drift is corrected the instant
	ProjHit snaps the final position.

	API:
	 ProjectileClient.EnableClientRendering()          -- call once on the client
	 ProjectileClient.SetImpactHandler(fn(position, normal, model, kind))
	     -- replaces the built-in flash/ring effect; see Impact.luau
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Heartbeat = require(Shared.Heartbeat)
local ChunkManager = require(Shared.ChunkManager)
local ProjectileMotion = require(Shared.ProjectileMotion)
local VisualOffload = require(Shared.VisualOffload)

local VisualModel = require(script.VisualModel)
local Impact = require(script.Impact)
local DebugRays = require(script.DebugRays)

local ProjectileClient = {}

function ProjectileClient.SetImpactHandler(fn)
	Impact.SetHandler(fn)
end

-- Matches ServerScriptService.Server.Projectile's own default -- used only as
-- a fallback if a ProjSpawn payload is ever missing MaxRealLifetime, which
-- shouldn't normally happen (the server always includes it).
local DEFAULT_MAX_REAL_LIFETIME = 60

-- Real (undilated) seconds of no ProjMove update before a SYNCED visual is
-- assumed to have left VisualRange and gets cleaned up -- see the render
-- loop below. Generous on purpose: ProjMove batches normally arrive every
-- server tick, so anything this stale really has stopped, not just lagged.
local SYNCED_VISUAL_STALE_TIMEOUT = 2
local MAX_PREDICTION_SUBSTEPS = 16
local PREDICTION_CURVE_ERROR = 0.35
local MIN_STEP_DT = 1e-5
-- Hard cap on visible Transform work in one client frame. Off-screen visuals
-- still advance logically when visited but consume no transform budget. The
-- persistent round-robin cursor is independent of dilated time, so changing
-- GlobalTimeScale cannot collapse previously staggered cohorts onto one frame.
local MAX_VISUAL_UPDATES_PER_FRAME = 2500
local VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN = 128 -- pixels beyond each edge; avoids boundary flicker
local SMOOTH_RADIUS = 100
local MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES = 500
local SMOOTH_SET_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 0.1 -- real seconds; selection is presentation-only
local DEFAULT_SMOOTH_DURATION = 1 / 60

local clientRendering = false
local visuals = {} -- [id] = { model, position, velocity, gravity, homing/bounce state, ... }
local visualOrder = {} -- append-only between compactions; dead ids are tombstones
local visualCursor = 1
local visualTombstones = 0
local globalSimulationClock = 0
local smoothVisuals = {}
local nextSmoothSetRefresh = 0

local function isInView(position: Vector3): boolean
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return true
	end
	local viewportPoint = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	local viewportSize = camera.ViewportSize
	return viewportPoint.Z > 0
		and viewportPoint.X >= -VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN
		and viewportPoint.Y >= -VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN
		and viewportPoint.X <= viewportSize.X + VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN
		and viewportPoint.Y <= viewportSize.Y + VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN
end

local function refreshSmoothVisuals(now: number)
	if now < nextSmoothSetRefresh then
		return
	end
	nextSmoothSetRefresh = now + SMOOTH_SET_REFRESH_INTERVAL

	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart)
	local candidates = {}
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		local radiusSq = SMOOTH_RADIUS * SMOOTH_RADIUS
		for _, visual in visuals do
			local offset = visual.position - root.Position
			local distanceSq = offset:Dot(offset)
			if distanceSq <= radiusSq and isInView(visual.position) then
				table.insert(candidates, { Visual = visual, DistanceSq = distanceSq })
			end
		end
		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
			return a.DistanceSq < b.DistanceSq
		end)
	end

	local selected = {}
	local newSmoothVisuals = table.create(math.min(#candidates, MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES))
	for index = 1, math.min(#candidates, MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES) do
		local visual = candidates[index].Visual
		selected[visual] = true
		table.insert(newSmoothVisuals, visual)
		if not visual.smoothTransform then
			visual.smoothTransform = true
			visual.lastSmoothStep = now
			visual.lastSmoothTarget = nil
		end
	end
	for _, visual in smoothVisuals do
		if not selected[visual] then
			visual.smoothTransform = false
			visual.lastSmoothStep = nil
			visual.lastSmoothTarget = nil
		end
	end
	smoothVisuals = newSmoothVisuals
end

local function setSmoothTarget(visual, now: number)
	local previousTarget = visual.lastSmoothTarget
	local duration = if previousTarget then math.clamp(now - previousTarget, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_DURATION, 0.1)
		else DEFAULT_SMOOTH_DURATION
	visual.lastSmoothTarget = now
	VisualModel.SetTarget(visual, visual.position, visual.velocity, duration)
end

local function simulateVisual(visual, baseDt: number): (boolean, boolean)
	if baseDt <= 0 then
		return true, false
	end

	local remaining = baseDt + (visual.simulationDebt or 0)
	visual.simulationDebt = 0
	local moved = false
	local guard = 0
	while remaining > MIN_STEP_DT and guard < MAX_PREDICTION_SUBSTEPS do
		guard += 1
		local accelerationVector = ProjectileMotion.GetAcceleration(
			visual.velocity,
			visual.acceleration,
			visual.accelerationDirection,
			visual.gravity
		)
		local direction = visual.velocity
		if direction.Magnitude < 1e-5 then
			direction = accelerationVector.Magnitude >= 1e-5 and accelerationVector or Vector3.zAxis
		end
		direction = direction.Unit

		local samplePosition = visual.position + direction * ProjectileMotion.PositionEpsilon
		local chunkScale = ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(samplePosition)
		if chunkScale <= 0 then
			remaining = 0
			break
		end

		local availableDt = remaining * chunkScale
		if visual.life <= MIN_STEP_DT then
			return false, moved
		end

		local predictedVelocity = visual.velocity + accelerationVector * availableDt
		local estimatedMovementVelocity = (visual.velocity + predictedVelocity) * 0.5
		local speed = estimatedMovementVelocity.Magnitude
		local stepDt = math.min(availableDt, visual.life)
		if speed > 1e-5 then
			local maxDistance = ProjectileMotion.GetAdaptiveMaxDistance(speed, true)
			stepDt = math.min(stepDt, maxDistance / speed)
			local chunkBoundaryDt = ProjectileMotion.GetTimeScaleBoundaryDt(
				visual.position,
				estimatedMovementVelocity,
				ChunkManager.ChunkSize,
				ChunkManager.UseY,
				chunkScale,
				stepDt,
				ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt
			)
			local radialBoundaryDt = ChunkManager.GetRadialTimeScaleBoundaryDt(
				visual.position,
				estimatedMovementVelocity,
				stepDt
			)
			stepDt = math.min(stepDt, chunkBoundaryDt, radialBoundaryDt)
		end
		stepDt = math.min(
			stepDt,
			ProjectileMotion.GetCurvatureStepDt(visual.velocity, accelerationVector, PREDICTION_CURVE_ERROR)
		)
		if stepDt <= MIN_STEP_DT then
			visual.simulationDebt = remaining
			break
		end

		local movementVelocity
		visual.velocity, movementVelocity = ProjectileMotion.Integrate(
			visual.velocity,
			visual.acceleration,
			visual.accelerationDirection,
			visual.gravity,
			visual.minSpeed,
			visual.maxSpeed,
			stepDt
		)
		visual.position += movementVelocity * stepDt
		visual.life -= stepDt
		remaining = math.max(remaining - stepDt / chunkScale, 0)
		moved = true

		if visual.life <= MIN_STEP_DT then
			return false, moved
		end
	end

	if remaining > MIN_STEP_DT and visual.simulationDebt == 0 then
		visual.simulationDebt = remaining
	end
	return true, moved
end

-- Removes the flying tracer. Impact VFX is played from the ProjHit handler
-- itself (see EnableClientRendering), so this fires for real hits AND harmless
-- expiry without ever flashing in mid-air. The bullet DISAPPEARS instantly
-- (VisualModel.FadeOut hides every part and disables every
-- trail/particle/beam), but the actual :Destroy() waits out the longest
-- lifetime among the effects that were emitting -- already-spawned trail
-- segments and particles keep fading naturally during that grace window
-- instead of being cut off mid-air (or the spawn-configured DestroyDelay,
-- whichever is longer).
local function destroyVisual(id)
	local visual = visuals[id]
	if not visual then
		return
	end
	visuals[id] = nil
	visualTombstones += 1
	local delay =
		math.max(visual.destroyDelay or 0, VisualModel.FadeOut(visual.model, visual.waitForParticles, visual.waitForTrails))
	if delay > 0 then
		task.delay(delay, function()
			visual.model:Destroy()
		end)
	else
		visual.model:Destroy()
	end
end

function ProjectileClient.EnableClientRendering()
	if clientRendering or RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	clientRendering = true

	VisualOffload.On("ProjSpawn", function(data)
		local model, rig = VisualModel.Build(data)
		local now = os.clock()
		local visual = {
			id = data.Id,
			model = model,
			rig = rig,
			destroyDelay = data.DestroyDelay or 0,
			-- See VisualModel.FadeOut -- both default true.
			waitForParticles = data.WaitForParticles ~= false,
			waitForTrails = data.WaitForTrails ~= false,
			lastUpdate = now,
			lastRenderStep = now,
			lastSimulationTime = globalSimulationClock,

			position = data.Position,
			velocity = data.Velocity,
			gravity = data.Gravity or 0,
			acceleration = data.Acceleration or 0,
			accelerationDirection = data.AccelerationDirection,
			minSpeed = data.MinSpeed or 0,
			maxSpeed = data.MaxSpeed or math.huge,
			life = data.Lifetime or 5,
			simulationDebt = 0,

			synced = data.Synced == true,
			-- Combined Source.TimeScale * projectile.TimeScale at spawn time;
			-- updated live via ProjTimeScale below, folded into the unsynced
			-- render loop's local dead-reckoning -- see the module doc
			-- comment's "Local time" section.
			timeScale = data.TimeScale or 1,
			-- Real (undilated) safety-net cap -- see MaxRealLifetime / the
			-- render loop below. spawnRealTime is THIS client's own os.clock()
			-- at spawn, not the server's -- fine, since this only needs to be
			-- a generous backstop, not an exact match to the server's own cap.
			spawnRealTime = now,
			maxRealLifetime = data.MaxRealLifetime or DEFAULT_MAX_REAL_LIFETIME,
			inView = isInView(data.Position),
			effectCullDelay = VisualModel.GetLongestEffectLifetime(model),
			culled = false,
		}
		if not visual.inView then
			visual.offscreenSince = now
		end
		if data.ActivateParticlesOnCreate then
			VisualModel.ActivateParticles(model)
		end
		visuals[data.Id] = visual
		table.insert(visualOrder, data.Id)
	end)

	-- Fires only when the combined personal/local TimeScale actually changes
	-- (see Projectile:_checkTimeScaleChange) -- not a per-frame stream. The
	-- client just needed to know the number; from here it predicts locally
	-- exactly like it already does for chunk/world dilation.
	VisualOffload.On("ProjTimeScale", function(data)
		local visual = visuals[data.Id]
		if visual then
			visual.timeScale = data.TimeScale
		end
	end)

	-- Sync state changed (homing lock acquired/dropped, or bounces just ran
	-- out) -- rare, only on an actual transition, never per-frame. Synced
	-- switches the visual into "trust the streamed ProjMove" mode; unsynced
	-- switches it back to local physics from wherever the last authoritative
	-- Position/Velocity left it.
	VisualOffload.On("ProjSync", function(data)
		local visual = visuals[data.Id]
		if visual then
			visual.synced = data.Synced == true
			if visual.synced then
				visual.simulationDebt = 0
				-- reset the staleness clock right at the transition -- see the
				-- synced branch of the render loop below -- so a lastUpdate
				-- left over from before this transition (however old) can't
				-- immediately read as stale before the first real ProjMove
				-- arrives.
				visual.lastUpdate = os.clock()
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Batched authoritative pose updates (an array covering every entry that
	-- needs one this frame, not one event each). Two kinds of entries arrive
	-- here, handled differently:
	--  - Bounced = true: a one-shot bounce correction, sent regardless of
	--    whether the visual is currently in continuous-sync mode (a
	--    non-homing bouncer is normally fully unsynced -- see the module doc
	--    comment -- so this is the ONLY update it ever gets between spawn and
	--    impact). Always applied unconditionally: snap instead of tweening,
	--    since tweening a straight line from the old position would cut
	--    through whatever surface sits between them (exactly where the
	--    bounce occurred), play the ricochet flash, and re-baseline
	--    position/velocity so local physics (see the per-frame loop below)
	--    picks up from the correct post-reflection state.
	--  - Otherwise: a continuous homing-sync update, only meaningful (and
	--    only sent by the server) while visual.synced is true -- see the
	--    module doc comment for why homing can't be predicted client-side.
	VisualOffload.On("ProjMove", function(batch)
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, data in batch do
			local visual = visuals[data.Id]
			if visual and data.Bounced then
				visual.lastUpdate = now
				visual.position = data.Position
				visual.velocity = data.Velocity
				visual.simulationDebt = 0
				VisualModel.Place(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity)
				Impact.Play(data.Position, data.Normal, "bounce")
			elseif visual and visual.synced then
				local duration = math.clamp(now - visual.lastUpdate, 0.03, 0.2)
				visual.lastUpdate = now
				visual.position = data.Position
				visual.velocity = data.Velocity
				VisualModel.SetTarget(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity, duration)
			end
		end
	end)

	VisualOffload.On("ProjHit", function(data)
		local visual = visuals[data.Id]
		if visual then
			-- Snap to the server's exact position before destroying, so any
			-- imperceptible mid-flight drift from local simulation never shows
			-- at the one moment it would be visible.
			VisualModel.Place(visual, data.Position, visual.velocity)
			if data.Kind then
				Impact.Play(data.Position, data.Normal, data.Kind)
			end
		end
		destroyVisual(data.Id)
	end)

	VisualOffload.On("ProjRay", function(data)
		DebugRays.Draw(data.From, data.To, data.LowRes)
	end)

	-- Every projectile visual gets exactly one ProjSpawn and, eventually, one
	-- ProjHit. For an UNSYNCED visual (the common case: no active homing lock
	-- -- this includes a bouncer between bounces, since bouncing no longer
	-- keeps a visual continuously synced, see the module doc comment), this
	-- loop is the entire simulation in between -- it integrates
	-- acceleration/gravity/position on its round-robin update using all global
	-- dt accumulated since that visual's previous update and the same chunk dt
	-- pipeline the server's Step uses (ChunkManager.ScaleDt). No raycasting
	-- ever happens here -- a SYNCED visual (actively homing onto a target)
	-- skips all of that -- its Position/Velocity/pose are driven entirely by
	-- the streamed ProjMove handler above; see the module doc comment for why
	-- that case can't be safely predicted client-side. A bouncing visual's
	-- position/velocity get corrected in-place by the one-shot Bounced
	-- ProjMove entry each time it bounces (handled above, independent of
	-- visual.synced), and this loop just keeps integrating forward from
	-- whatever that correction left behind. All of this is purely cosmetic;
	-- the server always runs its own independent, authoritative Step, and any
	-- drift is corrected the instant ProjHit snaps the final position.
	local function compactVisualOrder()
		local oldOrder = visualOrder
		local oldCount = #oldOrder
		local compacted = table.create(math.max(oldCount - visualTombstones, 0))
		-- Begin at the next due slot so compaction preserves round-robin fairness.
		for offset = 0, oldCount - 1 do
			local index = (visualCursor + offset - 1) % oldCount + 1
			local id = oldOrder[index]
			if visuals[id] then
				table.insert(compacted, id)
			end
		end
		visualOrder = compacted
		visualCursor = 1
		visualTombstones = 0
	end

	Heartbeat.Connect(function(globalDt)
		globalSimulationClock += globalDt
		local now = os.clock()
		refreshSmoothVisuals(now)
		local slotCount = #visualOrder
		local inspected = 0
		local transformed = 0
		while inspected < slotCount and transformed < MAX_VISUAL_UPDATES_PER_FRAME do
			if visualCursor > slotCount then
				visualCursor = 1
			end
			local id = visualOrder[visualCursor]
			visualCursor += 1
			inspected += 1
			local visual = visuals[id]
			if not visual then
				continue
			end
			local elapsedGlobalDt = math.max(globalSimulationClock - visual.lastSimulationTime, 0)
			visual.lastSimulationTime = globalSimulationClock
			-- Real (undilated) backstop, checked unconditionally before the
			-- synced/unsynced split below -- mirrors the server's own
			-- MaxRealLifetime check (see Step). Primarily this is redundant
			-- with ProjHit already destroying the visual the instant the
			-- server actually expires it; this exists purely as a client-only
			-- fallback in case that message is ever missed (e.g. the visual
			-- drifted outside VisualRange), so a visual can never linger
			-- forever regardless of dt/freeze state -- same reasoning as the
			-- server-side fix this mirrors.
			if now - visual.spawnRealTime >= visual.maxRealLifetime then
				destroyVisual(id)
				continue
			end

			if visual.synced then
				local inView = isInView(visual.position)
				if inView then
					transformed += 1
					if not visual.inView then
						-- Suppress trail history only for the re-entry teleport.
						-- Particles kept emitting throughout the off-screen grace
						-- period unless the visual actually reached full culling.
						VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
						VisualModel.Place(visual, visual.position, visual.velocity)
						if visual.culled then
							VisualModel.SetCulled(visual, false)
							visual.culled = false
						end
						visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate = now
						visual.offscreenSince = nil
					elseif not visual.smoothTransform then
						if visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate then
							VisualModel.ResumeEffects(visual)
							visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate = nil
						end
						local realDt = math.max(now - visual.lastRenderStep, 0)
						VisualModel.Step(visual, realDt)
					end
					visual.lastRenderStep = now
				else
					if visual.inView or not visual.offscreenSince then
						visual.offscreenSince = now
					end
					if not visual.culled and now - visual.offscreenSince >= visual.effectCullDelay then
						VisualModel.SuspendEffects(visual)
						VisualModel.SetCulled(visual, true)
						visual.culled = true
					end
				end
				visual.inView = inView
				-- Position/velocity/pose come from ProjMove; the only thing
				-- that runs here is a left-VisualRange safety net. This is
				-- deliberately wall-clock (os.clock()), NOT a dilated-dt
				-- countdown: a synced visual can belong to a shooter at ANY
				-- personal time ratio, including exactly 0 (a legitimate
				-- indefinite freeze the player chose), so there's no dilated
				-- "Lifetime elapsed" schedule the client could reconstruct on
				-- its own without knowing that live ratio (which isn't
				-- replicated to observers -- see the module doc comment's
				-- "Personal time" section). Instead: the server round-robins every
				-- synced projectile through bounded ProjMove batches regardless of
				-- dt (see the server step loop), so as long as
				-- this client is in VisualRange, lastUpdate keeps getting
				-- refreshed; once it stops (genuinely left range, or the
				-- projectile is gone), a real-time timeout cleans it up.
				if now - visual.lastUpdate > SYNCED_VISUAL_STALE_TIMEOUT then
					destroyVisual(id)
				end
				continue
			end

			-- visual.timeScale is the combined Source.TimeScale *
			-- projectile.TimeScale, kept current via the (rare, on-change
			-- only) ProjTimeScale handler above -- see the module doc
			-- comment's "Local time" section. simulateVisual consumes that
			-- time across chunk boundaries using each entered chunk's own scale.
			local alive, moved = simulateVisual(visual, elapsedGlobalDt * visual.timeScale)
			local inView = isInView(visual.position)
			if inView then
				transformed += 1
				if not visual.inView then
					VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
					VisualModel.Place(visual, visual.position, visual.velocity)
				elseif moved and visual.smoothTransform then
					setSmoothTarget(visual, now)
				elseif moved then
					VisualModel.Place(visual, visual.position, visual.velocity)
				end
				if not visual.inView then
					if visual.culled then
						VisualModel.SetCulled(visual, false)
						visual.culled = false
					end
					visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate = now
					visual.offscreenSince = nil
				elseif visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate then
					VisualModel.ResumeEffects(visual)
					visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate = nil
				end
				visual.lastRenderStep = now
			else
				if visual.inView or not visual.offscreenSince then
					visual.offscreenSince = now
				end
				if not visual.culled and now - visual.offscreenSince >= visual.effectCullDelay then
					VisualModel.SuspendEffects(visual)
					VisualModel.SetCulled(visual, true)
					visual.culled = true
				end
			end
			visual.inView = inView
			if not alive then
				-- Safety net: normally ProjHit arrives first and removes this
				-- entry. This only fires if it never does (e.g. the
				-- projectile left this client's VisualRange).
				destroyVisual(id)
			end
		end

		-- Nearby visuals receive presentation-only interpolation every real frame.
		-- Their logical simulation and network snapshots remain in the bounded
		-- scheduler above, so this adds at most MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES transforms.
		for _, visual in smoothVisuals do
			if visual.inView and visuals[visual.id] == visual then
				if visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate and visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate < now then
					VisualModel.ResumeEffects(visual)
					visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate = nil
				end
				local lastStep = visual.lastSmoothStep or now
				VisualModel.Step(visual, math.max(now - lastStep, 0))
				visual.lastSmoothStep = now
			end
		end

		-- Avoid an ever-growing sparse order array without changing which live
		-- visual is next. This is metadata work only; it performs no transforms.
		if visualTombstones >= 256 and visualTombstones * 4 >= #visualOrder then
			compactVisualOrder()
		end
	end, { Name = "ProjectileSystem.ClientSimulate", Priority = 5 })
end

return ProjectileClient
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/init.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/DebugRays.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/DebugRays.luau
	Draws one raycast segment as a thin fading line, colored by resolution --
	receives ProjRay events streamed while the server's Projectile.SetDebugRays
	is on (see example/init.server.luau's "SetProjectileDebug" handler).
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local DebugRays = {}

-- Red = coarse cast through an empty chunk; green = fine cast near entities.
local RAY_LOWRES_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
local RAY_HIGHRES_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 140)

function DebugRays.Draw(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, lowRes: boolean?)
	local delta = to - from
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	if dist < 1e-3 then
		return
	end
	local line = Instance.new("Part")
	line.Anchored = true
	line.CanCollide = false
	line.CanQuery = false
	line.CanTouch = false
	line.CastShadow = false
	line.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	line.Color = lowRes and RAY_LOWRES_COLOR or RAY_HIGHRES_COLOR
	line.Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, dist)
	line.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) * 0.5, to)
	line.Transparency = 0.15
	line.Parent = workspace
	TweenService:Create(line, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	task.delay(0.3, function()
		line:Destroy()
	end)
end

return DebugRays
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/DebugRays.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/Impact.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/Impact.luau
	Hit-effect visuals -- a short neon flash + spreading ring at the impact
	point, color-coded by what was struck. Games can swap this out entirely
	via Impact.SetHandler(fn(position, normal, model, kind)).
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Impact = {}

-- Custom impact hook: fn(position, normal, model?, kind). When set, it replaces
-- the built-in effect below. (model is nil for impacts; kind is
-- "entity" | "world" | "bounce".)
local impactHandler: ((Vector3, Vector3, Instance?, string?) -> ())? = nil

function Impact.SetHandler(fn)
	impactHandler = fn
end

local IMPACT_COLORS = {
	entity = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), -- hit a damageable target
	world = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 150), -- hit geometry
	bounce = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), -- ricochet
}

local function defaultImpact(position: Vector3, normal: Vector3, kind: string?)
	local color = IMPACT_COLORS[kind or "world"] or IMPACT_COLORS.world
	local big = kind ~= "bounce"
	local info = TweenInfo.new(big and 0.28 or 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

	-- expanding core flash
	local burst = Instance.new("Part")
	burst.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	burst.Size = Vector3.one * (big and 0.6 or 0.3)
	burst.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
	burst.Anchored = true
	burst.CanCollide = false
	burst.CanQuery = false
	burst.CanTouch = false
	burst.CastShadow = false
	burst.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	burst.Color = color
	burst.Transparency = 0.1
	burst.Parent = workspace
	TweenService:Create(burst, info, { Size = Vector3.one * (big and 3.5 or 1.5), Transparency = 1 }):Play()

	-- flat ring spreading along the surface (Cylinder's length runs along local X,
	-- so aim X down the normal and keep it thin there)
	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 0.5, 0.5)
	local n = normal.Magnitude > 1e-3 and normal.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
	ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(position, position + n) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	ring.CanTouch = false
	ring.CastShadow = false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Color = color
	ring.Transparency = 0.2
	ring.Parent = workspace
	local ringSpan = big and 4 or 2
	TweenService:Create(ring, info, { Size = Vector3.new(0.12, ringSpan, ringSpan), Transparency = 1 }):Play()

	task.delay(info.Time, function()
		burst:Destroy()
		ring:Destroy()
	end)
end

function Impact.Play(position: Vector3, normal: Vector3?, kind: string?)
	local n = normal or Vector3.yAxis
	if impactHandler then
		task.spawn(impactHandler, position, n, nil, kind)
	else
		defaultImpact(position, n, kind)
	end
end

return Impact
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/Impact.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/VisualModel.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/VisualModel.luau
	Builds and positions the actual Instance a projectile visual renders as.
	Pure presentation -- no networking, no gameplay state.
]]

local VisualModel = {}

-- Defaults for ActivateParticlesOnCreate (see VisualModel.ActivateParticles)
-- when a ParticleEmitter doesn't carry its own EmitCount/EmitDelay attribute.
local DEFAULT_EMIT_COUNT = 5
local DEFAULT_EMIT_DELAY = 0

local function safeUnit(v: Vector3, fallback: Vector3): Vector3
	local magnitude = v.Magnitude
	if magnitude < 1e-5 then
		return fallback
	end
	return v / magnitude
end

local function poseFrom(position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3): CFrame
	return CFrame.new(position, position + safeUnit(velocity, Vector3.zAxis))
end

function VisualModel.Build(data): (Instance, any)
	local model

	if data.Model then
		model = data.Model:Clone()
	else
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		local spec = data.Visual
		if spec then
			if spec.Shape == "Ball" then
				part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			elseif spec.Shape == "Cylinder" then
				part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			end
			part.Size = spec.Size or Vector3.one * 0.5
			part.Color = spec.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		else
			part.Size = Vector3.one * 0.4
			part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120)
		end
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		model = part
	end

	-- Scale the cloned presentation once at construction. This does not add
	-- any per-frame work and keeps gameplay collision radius server-owned.
	local visualScale = math.clamp(data.VisualScale or 1, 0.05, 20)
	if visualScale ~= 1 then
		if model:IsA("Model") then
			pcall(model.ScaleTo, model, model:GetScale() * visualScale)
		elseif model:IsA("BasePart") then
			model.Size *= visualScale
		end
	end
	local root: BasePart?
	local pivot: CFrame
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		root = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		pivot = model:GetPivot()
		for _, part in { model, table.unpack(model:GetDescendants()) } do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.Anchored = false
				part.CanCollide = false
				part.CanQuery = false
				part.CanTouch = false
				part.CastShadow = false
			end
		end
	else
		root = model
		pivot = model.CFrame
		model.Anchored = false
		model.CanCollide = false
		model.CanQuery = false
		model.CanTouch = false
		model.CastShadow = false
	end

	-- Drive the visual as an assembly from one stationary, invisible root. A
	-- Motor6D Transform is considerably cheaper to update every render frame
	-- than creating/cancelling Tween instances or repeatedly moving a model
	-- pivot. rootOffset preserves a custom Model's authored pivot.
	local rig
	if root then
		local driver = Instance.new("Part")
		driver.Name = "ProjectileMotorRoot"
		driver.Size = Vector3.one * 0.05
		driver.Transparency = 1
		driver.Anchored = true
		driver.CanCollide = false
		driver.CanQuery = false
		driver.CanTouch = false
		driver.CastShadow = false
		driver.CFrame = CFrame.new(data.Position)
		driver.Parent = model

		local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
		motor.Name = "ProjectileTransform"
		motor.Part0 = driver
		motor.Part1 = root
		motor.Parent = driver

		local rootOffset = pivot:ToObjectSpace(root.CFrame)
		motor.Transform = driver.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(poseFrom(data.Position, data.Velocity) * rootOffset)
		rig = {
			driver = driver,
			motor = motor,
			rootOffset = rootOffset,
		}
	end

	model.Parent = workspace
	return model, rig
end

local function transformFor(visual, pose: CFrame): CFrame?
	local rig = visual.rig
	if not rig then
		return nil
	end
	return rig.driver.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(pose * rig.rootOffset)
end

local function placeFallback(model: Instance, pose: CFrame)
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		model:PivotTo(pose)
	elseif model:IsA("BasePart") then
		model.CFrame = pose
	end
end

function VisualModel.Place(visual, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3)
	visual.transformFrom = nil
	visual.transformTo = nil

	local pose = poseFrom(position, velocity)
	local transform = transformFor(visual, pose)
	if transform then
		visual.rig.motor.Transform = transform
	else
		placeFallback(visual.model, pose)
	end
end

-- Preserve exactly which trails were emitting, then clear their positional
-- history before a culled visual is moved. Keeping them disabled until a later
-- render turn prevents Roblox from drawing a segment between the old and new
-- transforms.
function VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
	if visual.suspendedTrails then
		return
	end
	local suspended = {}
	for _, instance in visual.model:GetDescendants() do
		if instance:IsA("Trail") and instance.Enabled then
			instance.Enabled = false
			instance:Clear()
			table.insert(suspended, instance)
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedTrails = suspended
end

function VisualModel.ResumeTrails(visual)
	local suspended = visual.suspendedTrails
	if not suspended then
		return
	end
	for _, trail in suspended do
		if trail.Parent then
			trail:Clear()
			trail.Enabled = true
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedTrails = nil
end

-- Returns the real-time grace period a visual should remain alive and
-- emitting after it first leaves the viewport. EmitDelay is included because
-- one-shot particle bursts may not have fired yet when the projectile exits.
function VisualModel.GetLongestEffectLifetime(model: Instance): number
	local longest = 0
	for _, instance in model:GetDescendants() do
		if instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local emitDelay = instance:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")
			if typeof(emitDelay) ~= "number" then
				emitDelay = 0
			end
			longest = math.max(longest, math.max(emitDelay, 0) + instance.Lifetime.Max)
		elseif instance:IsA("Trail") then
			longest = math.max(longest, instance.Lifetime)
		end
	end
	return longest
end

-- Off-screen culling eventually stops both continuous particle emission and
-- trails, but only after GetLongestEffectLifetime has elapsed. Remember the
-- exact enabled set so authored-disabled effects stay disabled on re-entry.
function VisualModel.SuspendEffects(visual)
	VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
	if visual.suspendedParticles then
		return
	end
	local suspended = {}
	for _, instance in visual.model:GetDescendants() do
		if instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and instance.Enabled then
			instance.Enabled = false
			table.insert(suspended, instance)
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedParticles = suspended
end

function VisualModel.ResumeEffects(visual)
	VisualModel.ResumeTrails(visual)
	local suspended = visual.suspendedParticles
	if not suspended then
		return
	end
	for _, emitter in suspended do
		if emitter.Parent then
			emitter.Enabled = true
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedParticles = nil
end

-- Unparenting is a cheap, exact visual cull: the projectile cannot remain
-- frozen at its last on-screen transform, and Roblox has nothing to draw for
-- it while it is outside the camera. Place it before restoring the parent so
-- re-entry can never flash the stale exit pose for one frame.
function VisualModel.SetCulled(visual, culled: boolean)
	local model = visual.model
	if culled then
		if model.Parent then
			model.Parent = nil
		end
	elseif not model.Parent then
		model.Parent = workspace
	end
end

-- Instantly hides a bullet visual without destroying it: every BasePart goes
-- fully transparent, and every Trail/ParticleEmitter/Beam (and Light) is
-- either faded or deleted outright depending on waitForParticles/
-- waitForTrails (see the Projectile config's WaitForParticles/WaitForTrails --
-- both default true). Returns how many seconds of grace the caller should
-- wait before actually :Destroy()ing the model:
--  - waitForParticles/waitForTrails true (default): disabling a
--    Trail/ParticleEmitter only stops NEW emission, while everything already
--    emitted keeps fading out naturally over its Lifetime, so destroying any
--    earlier would cut those remnants off mid-air (the "unnatural deletion"
--    this exists to prevent) -- contributes that Lifetime to the grace period.
--  - waitForParticles/waitForTrails false: the instance is :Destroy()d
--    immediately instead of just disabled -- no lingering remnants, no grace
--    contribution from it.
-- Beams/Lights have no lingering emission (disabling hides them instantly)
-- and never contribute grace. Returns 0 (safe to destroy immediately) when
-- nothing in the model still needs to wait -- e.g. both flags false, or one
-- flag false and the model has none of the other kind.
function VisualModel.FadeOut(model: Instance, waitForParticles: boolean, waitForTrails: boolean): number
	local grace = 0
	for _, inst in { model, table.unpack(model:GetDescendants()) } do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			inst.Transparency = 1
		elseif inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if waitForParticles then
				if inst.Enabled then
					grace = math.max(grace, inst.Lifetime.Max)
				end
				inst.Enabled = false
			else
				inst:Destroy()
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Trail") then
			if waitForTrails then
				if inst.Enabled then
					grace = math.max(grace, inst.Lifetime)
				end
				inst.Enabled = false
			else
				inst:Destroy()
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Beam") then
			inst.Enabled = false
		elseif inst:IsA("Light") then
			inst.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	return grace
end

-- ActivateParticlesOnCreate support: fires every ParticleEmitter under
-- `model` exactly once via :Emit(), per its own EmitCount/EmitDelay
-- attributes (defaulting to 5 / 0s when either is missing). EmitDelay is
-- seconds from THIS call until that emitter actually emits -- 0 emits
-- inline, synchronously. Call once, right after VisualModel.Build.
function VisualModel.ActivateParticles(model: Instance)
	for _, inst in { model, table.unpack(model:GetDescendants()) } do
		if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local emitCount = inst:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
			if typeof(emitCount) ~= "number" then
				emitCount = DEFAULT_EMIT_COUNT
			end
			local emitDelay = inst:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")
			if typeof(emitDelay) ~= "number" then
				emitDelay = DEFAULT_EMIT_DELAY
			end
			if emitDelay > 0 then
				task.delay(emitDelay, function()
					if inst.Parent then
						inst:Emit(emitCount)
					end
				end)
			else
				inst:Emit(emitCount)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Starts a linear pose interpolation for a server-synced visual. The render
-- loop advances it by writing Motor6D.Transform; no Tween objects are created.
function VisualModel.SetTarget(visual, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3, duration: number)
	local target = transformFor(visual, poseFrom(position, velocity))
	if not target or duration <= 0 then
		VisualModel.Place(visual, position, velocity)
		return
	end

	visual.transformFrom = visual.rig.motor.Transform
	visual.transformTo = target
	visual.transformElapsed = 0
	visual.transformDuration = duration
end

function VisualModel.Step(visual, dt: number)
	local from = visual.transformFrom
	local target = visual.transformTo
	if not from or not target then
		return
	end

	local elapsed = visual.transformElapsed + dt
	local alpha = math.min(elapsed / visual.transformDuration, 1)
	visual.rig.motor.Transform = from:Lerp(target, alpha)
	visual.transformElapsed = elapsed
	if alpha >= 1 then
		visual.transformFrom = nil
		visual.transformTo = nil
	end
end

return VisualModel
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/VisualModel.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/server/ProjectileQuota.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
-- Shared live-projectile budget for weapons and compiled spells.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ProjectileQuota = {}
ProjectileQuota.Maximum = 150

local active: { [Player]: number } = {}

function ProjectileQuota.Get(player: Player): number
	return active[player] or 0
end

function ProjectileQuota.TryAcquire(player: Player, count: number?): boolean
	local amount = math.max(math.floor(count or 1), 0)
	if amount == 0 then
		return true
	end
	local current = active[player] or 0
	if current + amount > ProjectileQuota.Maximum then
		return false
	end
	active[player] = current + amount
	return true
end

function ProjectileQuota.Release(player: Player, count: number?)
	local amount = math.max(math.floor(count or 1), 0)
	active[player] = math.max((active[player] or 0) - amount, 0)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	active[player] = nil
end)

return ProjectileQuota
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/server/ProjectileQuota.luau
-- =============================================================================
